meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理小说创作项目，随时查看素材与文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有写网络小说的想法，希望有个地方统一管理素材和进度
copy.tagline_en: Manage your novel projects, browse outlines, and edit drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want one place to manage your materials and progress

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为网文工具箱的路由入口：先判断你的请求属于写长篇/短篇、拆文、扫榜、去AI味、封面等哪一类，再自动转到对应工具；还能查看项目状态、切换书目、检查更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、/网文 等命令，或说「我想写小说」等话时触发；请求比较模糊时也会由它来分发。

say.note: 会先问你写长篇还是短篇，再带到对应写作工具。
对比当前版本和最新版，只通知，不自动装。
列出项目里的书目，把选中的设为当前活跃书。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the router entry for the web-novel toolbox: it sorts requests (long/short writing, analysis, scanning, de-AI, cover, etc.) into the matching skill, and can check project status, switch active book, and check for updates.
howto.when_en: Triggered by commands like /story or /网文, or by phrases like "我想写小说"; it also activates when the request is vague and needs routing.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: It asks length, then routes to the matching tool.
Compares versions; notifies only, no auto-install.
Lists book directories and sets your chosen one as active.
